title: loweef Crypto Futures Fee Index
description:
Standard (VIP 0) USDT-margined perpetual futures taker/maker fees by exchange, the user fee-rebate rate available via loweef, and the resulting effective fee. Every row carries the date it was last checked against the exchange's official fee page.

Files: latest.json / latest.csv (full dataset), fees-only.json / fees-only.csv (exchange fees only, no rebate columns), changelog.json (every published change) and snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.json (immutable copy of the dataset on each day its content changed).

Method: https://loweef.io/en/crypto-futures-fee-index/#method

Disclosure: loweef is a fee-rebate service with affiliate ties to some of the listed exchanges; the fees-only files exclude all commercial fields.
